nodes.label: MARBERT Deep Transformer Model for Dialectal & MSA Arabic

nodes.label: HyperLogLog++ Probabilistic Graph Cardinality Estimation Engine
nodes.description: Probabilistic data structure algorithm providing near-constant memory estimation of distinct node neighborhood cardinalities and sub-graph union sizes.

nodes.label: W3C N-Quads RDF Dataset Line-Based Serialization Standard
nodes.description: Line-based plain text format for encoding RDF datasets, extending N-Triples with a fourth graph IRI field to support streamable named graphs.

nodes.label: NVIDIA CUDA Graph Execution & Launch Acceleration API
nodes.description: Hardware launch acceleration architecture representing GPU kernel execution workflows as explicit dependency graphs to eliminate CPU launch overhead.
